notes.title: Rolling back Language changes
notes.notes:
Rolling back the new Chinese and Russian localizations to work on fixing "quality" issues.

The new localizations can still be accessed on the staging branch though, just use the beta password "openlanguage".

Please see this guide for how to access password protected betas if interested: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1229485944

notes.notes:
We've pushed a new build of the game out today, it has a couple of fixes for the MacOS version.  Put into spoiler tags because of their spoiler nature

[spoiler]-wallpapers for macOS are no longer missing, so wallpaper changing puzzles should work again
[/spoiler]

[/spoiler]

Please let us know if you encounter any issues with the new update.

notes.title: Update to Mac Version
notes.notes:
Hi everyone :)

We have been working hard on improving the Mac version and we have some exciting news for you today:

- Achievements now register on macOS
- Added macOS Yosemite and El Capitan support (10.10 and 10.11)
- Optimized support for macOS Mojave
- Fixes macOS Mojave crash on dialogue box
- Pressing Ok+Cancel buttons simultaneously no longer crashes the game
- Minor script and map improvements

Shout out once again to Big thanks to Vinyl Darkscratch-Kazotetsu from Gooborg Studios[www.gooborg.com]for coding the macOS port!

Thanks for your playing!

notes.title: Patch released for Windows 10 October Update
notes.notes: We've patched the game to fix issues that users were having with the Windows 10 October Update (version 1809, you can check by running "winver" to see if you're affected).  So if you were unable to play due to getting the new Windows 10 October Update, this patch should fix things for you.  Please make sure you update the game before playing.

notes.title: Settings & Colorblind mode patch
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12709963/d8052c7ab3d4b94c396a7c3e20ebdf9d85e6867b.png

The game finally has a settings menu!  I'll explain what these settings do below:
-BGM volume:  lets you alter the in-game volume of background music and music effects (item pickup jingles)
-SFX volume:  lets you alter the in-game volume of sound effects
-Fullscreen:  lets you toggle fullscreen on and off (this can still be done with the F8 key)
-Default Movement:  lets you set either RUN or WALK to be the default movement for Niko, and holding the Shift key lets you use the other movement type
-Colorblind Mode:  lets you toggle colorblind mode.  When activated, 2 puzzles are modified slightly to be easier for colorblind players to solve
-Frameskip:  lets you toggle frameskip off and on.  If you are having issues where the game is dropping too many frames/seems too laggy, you will probably want to turn frameskip off
-Configure Controls:  doesn't actually do anything, just here to remind you that you can rebind the controls with the F1 key

Other changes that are in this patch:
-Game should no longer crash for some users when minimized or hidden
-Niko will now mention gas events are too tall if using bottle of pond water
-Can no longer save in final elevator (to prevent softlocking the game here), instead game autosaves right before and right after
-Can no longer get trapped by fisherman npc in glen
-Game will retry to put "important files" where they need to go when relaunching game near the end, which should fix issue of users not being able to find said files where they're supposed to be
-Minor map fixes
-Minor dialogue fixes
-Disabled opening both menus simultaneously when walking
-Handled error that occurs if you have the journal open when the game tries to copy it
-Put in condition to prevent "Niko is uneasy" infinite loop bug

notes.title: Dormitories map patch and other fixes
notes.notes:
We pushed a patch today to take care of a few issues:

-improved performance on some barrens maps, namely the Dormitories map
-gave Documents higher text contrast to make them easier to read
-replaced "SomeplaceIKnow" with new version (this had to be done)
-minor typo fix
-out of bounds fix in the Glen
-minor tile issues in the cliffs and the forest map
-fixed map transition on "start point" map
-fixed animation issues with lamplighter if you did a very specific set of actions
-can no longer open inventory and fast travel at the same time from the Menu
-fixed the bug when using fast travel on the observation deck

If you find any more bugs, please report them here in the bugs subforum, as we're still working on fixing all of them: http://steamcommunity.com/app/420530/discussions/1/
